Protect your investment with professional sealcoating from Striker Asphalt and Sealcoating, LLC. Over time, asphalt surfaces face constant wear from traffic, UV rays, oil spills, and harsh weather conditions. Our sealcoating services are designed to guard against that damage, extending the life of your pavement and restoring its clean, black finish.

We apply high-quality sealer using proven techniques that ensure a uniform coat and lasting protection. Whether it’s a driveway, parking lot, or private road, sealcoating helps reduce cracking, water penetration, and oxidation—making it one of the most cost-effective forms of pavement maintenance.

At Striker, we take the time to prepare each surface properly and apply every coat with precision. Our goal is to help you avoid costly repairs and maintain a safe, attractive surface year-round. Trust us to keep your pavement protected and looking its best.

Sealcoating isn’t just about appearance—it’s a crucial part of long-term pavement care. Here are some of the key benefits of sealing your asphalt:

1. Extends Pavement Life
Sealcoating adds a protective layer that shields your asphalt from the elements, slowing deterioration and prolonging its lifespan.

2. Protects Against Water & UV Damage
The sun and water are two of asphalt’s worst enemies. Sealcoating creates a barrier to prevent fading, drying, and cracking caused by UV rays and moisture.

3. Prevents Oxidation and Cracking
Unprotected asphalt oxidizes over time, making it brittle and more likely to crack. Sealcoating helps preserve flexibility and strength.

4.Enhances Appearance
A deep black finish gives your driveway or parking lot a like-new look, boosting curb appeal for homes and businesses alike.
